tasks.title: Seed scratch directory
tasks.description:
Minimal seeder task for the directory-mode integration fixture. Creates the
scratch parent directory that TASK-002 and TASK-003 write into. Lives in its
own child plan file so the integration harness has three distinct `plan_file`
basenames to route `commit-task` / `fail-task` / `block-dependents` against.
acceptance_criteria: Directory is committed via `scratch/.gitkeep` so git tracks it.

tasks.title: Write scratch/a.txt
tasks.description:
Parallel-batch leaf A in the TASK-004 directory-mode integration fixture.
Depends on TASK-001 (scratch seeder) but has no dependency on TASK-003, and
writes a disjoint leaf file so the orchestrator can run TASK-002 and TASK-003
concurrently. Lives in its own child plan file so `commit-task --plan-file
<this-basename>` flips only this file's Status bullet.
acceptance_criteria: `scratch/a.txt` exists and is a non-empty regular file.
Does NOT touch `scratch/b.txt` (file-lock disjointness invariant that lets TASK-002 and TASK-003 batch in parallel).

tasks.title: Write scratch/b.txt
tasks.description:
Parallel-batch leaf B in the TASK-004 directory-mode integration fixture.
Sibling to TASK-002; both depend on TASK-001 only and neither depends on the
other. Their `Files:` lists are disjoint, so the orchestrator batches them
together. Lives in its own child plan file so `block-dependents` in the
directory-mode cascade routes this task's `blocked` flip to this file while
TASK-002's flip lands in `TASK-002_write_a.md`.
acceptance_criteria: `scratch/b.txt` exists and is a non-empty regular file.
Does NOT touch `scratch/a.txt` (file-lock disjointness invariant that lets TASK-002 and TASK-003 batch in parallel).
